spans.text: For sexual arousal assessment, we used the German version of the SADI consisting of 53 items ( ), which was applied at time points: t-10 min, t+50 min, t+100 min, and t+150 min. Ratings are done on a 5-point Likert-scale, ranging from 0 (“does not describe it at all”) to 5 (“describes it perfectly”). Four scales can be derived from the SADI: evaluative , negative/aversive , physiological , and motivational aspects of sexual arousal and desire.
